questions.prompt: What two things does every custom helper in this chapter store?

options.explanation: Right. Claude projects, ChatGPT projects, custom GPTs and Gems all hold instructions and files.

options.text: A private model and its own training data
options.explanation: Each helper in the lesson saves instructions and files that its chats reuse.

options.text: Every past chat and every user's password
options.explanation: None of these products work that way. They store instructions and files.

questions.prompt: In a Claude project, where must a rule go so that Claude follows it?

options.text: In the project's name or description
options.explanation: Anthropic says Claude will not have access to the name and description.
Right. Claude uses the project instructions for all the chats within the project.

options.text: In one chat, said once at the start
options.explanation: Context isn't shared across chats in a project unless it is added to the project knowledge.

questions.prompt: Custom GPTs and Gems are both changing. What is the safest habit for a team?

options.text: Keep only the copy inside the tool, since it moves itself
options.explanation: OpenAI says custom actions must be rebuilt and the model does not carry over. A move still needs your own copy and tests.

options.text: Keep a master copy and test prompts outside the tool
options.explanation: Right. Then a move to a plugin or a skill is a copy and a test, not a rebuild from memory.

options.text: Stop using custom helpers until the products settle
options.explanation: That throws away the time they save. Keep your own copy and test after each move instead.
